origins.section: A Task That Waits for Its Subtasks Deadlocks an Ordinary Pool; ForkJoinPool's join() Keeps Working
Fork One Half, Compute the Other, Then Join
The Threshold Decides Whether Splitting Pays
The Common Pool Is Shared, So Blocking in It Delays Work You Didn't Write

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-map-tiles: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-map-tiles: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-map-tiles: b: 'In a ForkJoinPool a waiting thread keeps working... join() on a task that isn't done runs that task itself if it is still queued, or helps run the work of the worker that took it'; the 8,000,000-row run finished where the fixed pool hung.
recorded.prompt:q-word-count-order: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-word-count-order: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-word-count-order: a: 'Each task waits for its left half to finish before its right half starts, so at every level only one half is in progress.'
recorded.prompt:q-threshold-two: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-threshold-two: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-threshold-two: a: threshold table (10,000: 37 ms; 1,000,000: 42 ms vs 216 ms loop); flagged: the page's rows cost ~27 ns while 'summing prices' is cheaper. Stem changed afterwards to 'a few dozen nanoseconds of arithmetic per price' to match the page's run.
recorded.prompt:q-invoice-report: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-invoice-report: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-invoice-report: a: 'Parallel streams run in it, and so do CompletableFuture.supplyAsync...'; 'The workers were asleep in the lookups, and the pool can't tell.'
